PockPock Agent 0.2.6 makes agent tasks faster and more reliable with local models. Every feature from the research pages was tested on a real PC with a real model, and the problems found are fixed.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.5 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time. Your chats, settings and models are kept.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.5

### Faster agent steps
- Qwen 3.5 and 3.6 models no longer think silently before every tool call: Ollama ignored the setting PockPock used to turn that off. Each step now starts about 2.5 times sooner (0.6 s instead of 1.5 s on `qwen3.5:9b`).
- One agent task loads its model once, instead of two or three times.
- **Qwen 3.6** is supported: its chat replies are no longer empty.

### Agent tasks that used to fail
- A slow model is no longer cut off while planning: the planner waits as long as the model keeps writing.
- A plan the reviewer could not read is shown to you, marked as not reviewed, instead of failing with an error.
- "Read the files in this folder and …" now gets permission to read the folder you opened (shown in the plan you approve).
- The agent can read back a file it just saved, to check it.
- In long tasks, older results that are trimmed to save space keep their start and end, and the model is told to look again instead of guessing. Before, it could make up values.
- Plan-and-sequence: small plans (2 to 4 steps) are accepted, `.md` and `.txt` files are saved as text, and a step can read a file and then write one.

### Chat
- With **Automatic** model choice and no router model installed, chat uses the model already loaded, instead of an embedding model (which failed) or a large model that takes a long time to load.
- Embedding models no longer appear in the chat model menu.

## Good to know

- Tested live on an RTX 4070 SUPER (12 GB) with `qwen3.5:9b`: agent tasks, plan-and-sequence, long tasks that trigger context trimming, and chat. These were a few runs per feature, not a measured success rate.
- Qwen3.6-35B-A3B works, but on a 12 GB graphics card it runs mostly on the CPU: fine for chat, slow for agent tasks (a ten-file task took about 5 minutes, against 34 seconds on `qwen3.5:9b`).
- Help, screenshots and example prompts are in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki).
- Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
